title: Multiplication and division facts
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings and word problems. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show your work. For division that doesn't come out even, write the remainder (like 9 R 2).

items.prompt: What number goes in the box?  9 × ☐ = 63
38 students need rides. Each car holds 5 students. How many cars are full, and how many students are left over?
items.answer: 7 R 3 (7 full cars, 3 students left over)

items.prompt: A box holds 6 rows of 9 pencils. How many pencils is that?
What number goes in the box?  7 × ☐ = 56
50 cookies are packed in bags of 6. How many bags are full, and how many cookies are left over?
items.answer: 8 R 2 (8 full bags, 2 cookies left over)

items.prompt: There are 7 teams with 9 players on each team. How many players are there in all?
